acceptance: A measurement of scheduled versus expected sweep runs over at least 7 days is recorded
If the gap is real, the docs state the worst-case delay for a lost dispatch, or the sweep gains another trigger, decided with the oracle workstream
context: Found 2026-10-31 in an adversarial review of oracle queue load; counts came from gh run list. The cause (platform scheduling under load) is an inference. Oracle workflows are soundness paths; any change needs the oracle owner.
description: The oracle-gate sweep is the fallback when a dispatch is lost, and it is scheduled hourly (cron '41 * * * *'). On 2026-10-31 only 1 gate schedule run appeared in about 4 hours, and oracle-verdict had 3 schedule runs since 18:44 the previous day. GitHub drops or delays scheduled runs under load, so the fallback cannot be relied on for timing.
